detectors.title: The API is at capacity or failed on its side
detectors.pattern: Overloaded errors\. The API is at capacity|is experiencing high load|Internal server error\. This is a server-side issue|Server error mid-response
detectors.repro: API Error: Repeated Overloaded errors. The API is at capacity. This is usually temporary.

detectors.title: A plan usage window or spend limit ran out
detectors.pattern: You've hit your (session|weekly|Opus|Sonnet|Fable|monthly spend|individual spend|individual usage|org's monthly spend|channel's monthly spend) limit|You've hit your team's shared budget
detectors.repro: You've hit your weekly limit · resets Mon

detectors.title: A credential in the environment overrides or breaks the sign-in
detectors.pattern: Credit balance is too low|Invalid API key · Fix external API key|organization has disabled API key authentication|Your apiKeyHelper script is failing|Invalid auth token · Fix external auth token|Invalid ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS|Invalid request header from the environment
detectors.repro: Invalid API key · Fix external API key

detectors.title: The saved sign-in expired or was revoked
detectors.pattern: Not logged in · Please run /login|Login expired · Please run /login|OAuth token revoked|OAuth token has expired|OAuth session expired and could not be refreshed|Invalid authentication credentials|Could not resolve authentication method
detectors.repro: Login expired · Please run /login

detectors.title: The organization refuses this account or sign-in method
detectors.pattern: disabled Claude subscription access|Claude Code access has not been granted for this account|This organization has been disabled|Your account is on hold|Gateway refused the request|Request not allowed
detectors.repro: Your organization has disabled Claude subscription access for Claude Code · Use an Anthropic API key instead, or ask your admin to enable access

detectors.title: Claude Code cannot reach the API through the corporate network
detectors.pattern: Unable to connect to API\. Check your internet|Can't reach the API server|Couldn't connect through your proxy|ERR_PROXY_TUNNEL|Unable to connect to Anthropic services|Connection refused — a firewall or proxy|No internet route — check your connection or VPN|Connection dropped \(ECONNRESET\)|proxy refused the connection
detectors.repro: Couldn't connect through your proxy (ERR_PROXY_TUNNEL) — the proxy refused the tunnel: check its credentials and that it allows this host

detectors.title: A proxy or gateway rewrites, buffers or cuts the model stream
detectors.pattern: API returned an empty or malformed response|Streaming response ended before any complete data was received|Extra inputs are not permitted|Socket is closed|No response from API
detectors.repro: API returned an empty or malformed response (HTTP OK) — check for a proxy or gateway intercepting the request.

detectors.title: A TLS-inspecting proxy needs its root certificate authority trusted by every runtime separately
detectors.pattern: SSL certificate verification failed|UNABLE_TO_GET_ISSUER_CERT_LOCALLY|Could not create SSL/TLS secure channel|Could not establish trust relationship for the SSL/TLS secure channel|schannel: next InitializeSecurityContext failed
detectors.repro: Unable to connect to API: SSL certificate verification failed (UNABLE_TO_GET_ISSUER_CERT_LOCALLY).

detectors.title: The conversation no longer fits the context window
detectors.pattern: Prompt is too long|Context limit reached · /|Input is too long for requested model|Autocompact is thrashing|Agent descriptions are over the
detectors.repro: Context limit reached · /compact or /clear to continue

detectors.title: The request body is over the API byte limit
detectors.pattern: Request too large \(max|Request too large for the API|Image was too large|image dimensions exceed max allowed size|request_too_large
detectors.repro: Request too large (max <n>MB). Accumulated images and attachments in the conversation pushed the request over the limit.

detectors.title: The selected model is unknown, not on the plan or blocked by policy
detectors.pattern: There's an issue with the selected model|is not a recognized model id|is restricted by your organization's settings|Your organization restricts model selection|managed settings block the default model|allows only the models listed in "availableModels"|is not available with the Claude \w+ plan|Model '[^']+' not found
detectors.repro: There's an issue with the selected model (claude-x). It may not exist or you may not have access to it. Run /model to pick a different model.

detectors.title: Claude Code is older than the model or policy requires
detectors.pattern: does not support this model; version|older than the minimum version required by your organization
detectors.repro: API Error: Claude Code does not support this model; version <v> or newer is required. Run 'claude update'.

detectors.title: Tool-use history is out of step
detectors.pattern: due to tool use concurrency issues|orphaned tool_result in conversation history|duplicate tool_use ID in conversation history|unexpected `?tool_use_id`? found in `?tool_result`? blocks
detectors.repro: API Error: orphaned tool_result in conversation history. Run /rewind to recover the conversation.

detectors.title: An MCP server fails to start or drops
detectors.pattern: ✘ Failed to connect|MCP server "[^"]*" disconnected
detectors.repro: MCP server "docs" disconnected · open /mcp to reconnect

detectors.title: An MCP server needs its sign-in again
detectors.pattern: needs you to sign in again \(run /mcp|requires re-authorization \(token expired\)|needs additional permissions \(scope|rejected the credential from its headersHelper|rejected the Authorization header in its config|Issuer mismatch in authorization response|Incompatible auth server: does not support dynamic client registration
detectors.repro: MCP server "docs" requires re-authorization (token expired)

detectors.title: A policy denial is retried in another shape
detectors.pattern: is blocked by enterprise managed policy|managed settings allow only MCP servers that plugins provide|Cannot add MCP server to scope: managed|is disabled by your organization's policy|Managed settings were not approved
detectors.repro: MCP server docs is blocked by enterprise managed policy

detectors.title: A managed settings document cannot be read
detectors.pattern: Managed settings document could not be parsed|Remote managed settings failed to load|Unable to read managed policy settings|Managed settings drop-in directory could not be read
detectors.repro: Registry: HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\ClaudeCode\Settings: Managed settings document could not be parsed as a JSON object; none of its settings are in effect. Fix or remove it.

detectors.title: A hook fails and the action goes ahead anyway
detectors.pattern: Failed with non-blocking status code
detectors.repro: PreToolUse:Bash hook error: Failed with non-blocking status code: /bin/sh: /path/to/hook.sh: No such file or directory

detectors.title: No usable shell on Windows
detectors.pattern: requires either Git for Windows \(for bash\) or PowerShell|but Git Bash was not found|Denying Bash also turns off the PowerShell tool
detectors.repro: Claude Code on Windows requires either Git for Windows (for bash) or PowerShell

detectors.title: The installer runs in the wrong shell or is blocked by script policy
detectors.pattern: The token '&&' is not a valid statement separator|A parameter cannot be found that matches parameter name 'fsSL'|running scripts is disabled on this system|PSSecurityException
detectors.repro: npm.ps1 cannot be loaded because running scripts is disabled on this system.

detectors.title: The installer download returns a web page
detectors.pattern: `<!DOCTYPE html>'|App unavailable in region|Failed to fetch version from downloads|The connection dropped while downloading the update
detectors.repro: bash: line 1: `<!DOCTYPE html>'

detectors.title: A command-line tool is missing: command not found
detectors.pattern: Could not locate the Claude CLI on PATH
detectors.repro: Failed to run Claude Code: Error: Could not locate the Claude CLI on PATH.

detectors.title: Endpoint security software intercepts Claude Code's own files
detectors.pattern: Windows reported an error \(EBADF\)|Transcript writes are failing
detectors.repro: Windows reported an error (EBADF) when Claude Code read this session's transcript file, although the file had opened normally.

detectors.title: A network share is refused as a working directory
detectors.pattern: is a network path, which cannot be added as a working directory|path is network-shaped|that file is on a network share
detectors.repro: \\server\share is a network path, which cannot be added as a working directory.

detectors.title: The temp filesystem or disk quota is full
detectors.pattern: Your disk quota is full on the filesystem|or your disk quota on it, is full \(ENOSPC\)|Command output was lost: the temp filesystem|ENOSPC: no space left on device
detectors.repro: Command output was lost: the temp filesystem at <dir> is full

detectors.title: Project settings are ignored until the workspace is trusted
detectors.pattern: this workspace has not been trusted|headersHelper not run — this workspace has no persisted trust|Error: workspace not trusted
detectors.repro: Ignoring permissions.allow entries from .claude/settings.local.json: this workspace has not been trusted.

detectors.title: A permission rule is malformed or names the wrong tool
detectors.pattern: Malformed Tool\(content\) rule|is not matched by file permission checks|has a wildcard before the rest of the command
detectors.repro: Invalid permission rule "Bash(ls) x" was skipped: Malformed Tool(content) rule.

detectors.title: WebFetch cannot reach intranet hosts or its safety check is blocked
detectors.pattern: WebFetch cannot fetch localhost or other hostnames without a dot|Unable to verify if domain \S+ is safe to fetch|The safety check for domain \S+ is (temporarily )?rate-limited
detectors.repro: Unable to verify if domain wiki.example.com is safe to fetch. This may be due to network restrictions or enterprise security policies blocking claude.ai.

detectors.title: A safety check declines the conversation
detectors.pattern: appears to violate our Usage Policy|can't help with this\. Start a new session to continue|safeguards flagged this (message|session)|Output blocked by content filtering policy
detectors.repro: API Error: Output blocked by content filtering policy

detectors.title: Browser sign-in cannot open its local callback port
detectors.pattern: Failed to start OAuth callback server|OAuth callback port \d+ is already in use|No available ports for OAuth redirect|OAuth error: Invalid code
detectors.repro: Failed to start OAuth callback server: Failed to start server. Is port 0 in use?

detectors.title: Parallel fan-outs hit rate limits
detectors.pattern: Agent terminated early due to an API error|Request rejected \(\d+\) · this may be a temporary capacity
detectors.repro: Agent terminated early due to an API error: the request failed.

detectors.title: A helper program exists only as a shell script, so Windows cannot start it
detectors.pattern: pdftoppm is not installed
detectors.repro: pdftoppm is not installed. Install poppler-utils to read PDF pages.

detectors.title: The API is at capacity or failed on its side
detectors.pattern: ['"]api_error['"]|\btimeout_error\b|\boverloaded_error\b
detectors.repro: anthropic.InternalServerError: {'type': 'error', 'error': {'type': 'api_error', 'message': 'Internal server error'}}

detectors.title: Parallel fan-outs hit rate limits
detectors.pattern: \brate_limit_error\b
detectors.repro: anthropic.RateLimitError: {'type': 'error', 'error': {'type': 'rate_limit_error', 'message': 'Number of request tokens has exceeded your per-minute allowance'}}

detectors.title: A credential in the environment overrides or breaks the sign-in
detectors.pattern: \bbilling_error\b
detectors.repro: {'type': 'error', 'error': {'type': 'billing_error', 'message': 'Check your payment details'}}

detectors.title: The saved sign-in expired or was revoked
detectors.pattern: \bauthentication_error\b|\bauthentication_failed\b
detectors.repro: anthropic.AuthenticationError: {'type': 'error', 'error': {'type': 'authentication_error', 'message': 'invalid x-api-key'}}

detectors.title: The organization refuses this account or sign-in method
detectors.pattern: \bpermission_error\b|\boauth_org_not_allowed\b
detectors.repro: anthropic.PermissionDeniedError: {'type': 'error', 'error': {'type': 'permission_error', 'message': 'Your API key does not have permission to use the specified resource.'}}

detectors.title: The selected model is unknown, not on the plan or blocked by policy
detectors.pattern: \bnot_found_error\b|\bmodel_not_found\b
detectors.repro: anthropic.NotFoundError: {'type': 'error', 'error': {'type': 'not_found_error', 'message': 'model: claude-x'}}

detectors.title: An MCP server fails to start or drops
detectors.pattern: input_schema: JSON schema is invalid|Property keys should match pattern|No such tool available
detectors.repro: Error: No such tool available: mcp__docs__search

detectors.title: A model change is rejected by the API
detectors.pattern: max_tokens must be greater than thinking\.budget_tokens
detectors.repro: invalid_request_error: max_tokens must be greater than thinking.budget_tokens

detectors.title: Forgotten worktrees strand branches and their fixes
detectors.pattern: The current directory no longer exists|current working directory was deleted
detectors.repro: The current directory no longer exists (it was deleted or moved). Start Claude Code from an existing directory.

detectors.title: Parallel fan-outs hit rate limits
detectors.pattern: Concurrent subagent limit reached
detectors.repro: Concurrent subagent limit reached. Do not retry; wait for a running agent to finish.

detectors.title: The console code page crashes Python on non-ASCII output
detectors.pattern: UnicodeEncodeError|'charmap' codec can't (encode|decode)
detectors.repro: UnicodeEncodeError: 'charmap' codec can't encode character '\u2014' in position 4: character maps to <undefined>

detectors.title: Retrying fetches against hosts that never succeed
detectors.pattern: socket hang up|ECONNRESET|unable to fetch|domain is not accessible
detectors.repro: Error: socket hang up (ECONNRESET) while fetching https://example.com/page

detectors.title: A script assumes a data shape it never inspected
detectors.pattern: JSONDecodeError|Expecting value: line \d+ column \d+|Unexpected token < in JSON|Unexpected end of JSON input|'NoneType' object is not subscriptable
detectors.repro: json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)

detectors.title: Nested quotes across ssh, `bash -c` and `python -c`
detectors.pattern: unexpected EOF while looking for matching|unterminated quoted string|syntax error near unexpected token
detectors.repro: bash: -c: line 1: unexpected EOF while looking for matching `''

detectors.title: Git Bash rewrites arguments that look like paths
detectors.pattern: ambiguous argument 'origin\\main|C:/Program Files/Git/(repos|user|orgs|api)
detectors.repro: fatal: ambiguous argument 'origin\main;file.txt': unknown revision or path not in the working tree.

detectors.title: Quoting differs between PowerShell and Git Bash
detectors.pattern: The string is missing the terminator|Invalid JSON primitive|Expected property name enclosed in double quotes
detectors.repro: The string is missing the terminator: '.

detectors.title: Line endings: text-mode writes turn LF into CRLF
detectors.pattern: \$'\\r': command not found|bad interpreter|pipefail: invalid option|\^M
detectors.repro: run.sh: line 2: $'\r': command not found

detectors.title: A command-line tool is missing: command not found
detectors.pattern: (?<!\\r'): command not found|is not recognized as the name of a cmdlet|is not recognized as an internal or external command
detectors.repro: bash: jq: command not found

detectors.title: A Python script runs under the wrong interpreter
detectors.pattern: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named|No module named '
detectors.repro: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'yaml'

detectors.title: An async function is called without await
detectors.pattern: coroutine .* was never awaited|'coroutine' object is not (iterable|subscriptable)|\[object Promise\]
detectors.repro: RuntimeWarning: coroutine 'fetch_items' was never awaited

detectors.title: A migration runner halts silently or is not idempotent
detectors.pattern: duplicate column name|column .* already exists|relation .* already exists
detectors.repro: ERROR: column "status" of relation "items" already exists

detectors.title: Cross-origin API calls fail in bursts
detectors.pattern: TypeError: Failed to fetch|blocked by CORS policy|No 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin'
detectors.repro: Access to fetch at 'https://api.example.com/v1/items' from origin 'https://app.example.com' has been blocked by CORS policy

detectors.title: The server does not send its intermediate certificate
detectors.pattern: unable to verify the first certificate|UNABLE_TO_VERIFY_LEAF_SIGNATURE
detectors.repro: Error: unable to verify the first certificate

detectors.title: A TLS-inspecting proxy needs its root certificate authority trusted by every runtime separately
detectors.pattern: SELF_SIGNED_CERT_IN_CHAIN|self[- ]signed certificate in certificate chain|CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED|SSL certificate problem|unable to get local issuer certificate
detectors.repro: SSL certificate problem: self-signed certificate in certificate chain

detectors.title: Parallel fan-outs hit rate limits
detectors.pattern: rate limit|too many requests|usage limit|quota exceeded
detectors.repro: Rate limit exceeded. Retry after a few seconds.

detectors.title: Lockfile drift breaks frozen installs
detectors.pattern: ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE|npm ci can only install packages when your package.json and package-lock.json|lockfile .* not up to date
detectors.repro: ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE Cannot install with "frozen-lockfile" because pnpm-lock.yaml is not up to date with package.json

detectors.title: Forgotten worktrees strand branches and their fixes
detectors.pattern: checked out at|already used by worktree
detectors.repro: error: Cannot delete branch 'fix-x' checked out at '/work/wt-fix'

detectors.title: Scripts lose their executable bit when committed from Windows
detectors.pattern: \./[\w./-]+: Permission denied
detectors.repro: bash: ./deploy.sh: Permission denied

detectors.title: Hook and agent definitions are snapshotted per session
detectors.pattern: agent type '[^']*' not found
detectors.repro: Agent type 'my-reviewer' not found. Available agents: general-purpose, Explore, Plan

detectors.title: Reading a whole large file exceeds the read limit
detectors.pattern: exceeds maximum allowed tokens
detectors.repro: File content (<n> tokens) exceeds maximum allowed tokens (<limit>). Use offset and limit to read part of the file.

detectors.title: Invented file paths
detectors.pattern: File does not exist|Directory does not exist
detectors.repro: File does not exist. Did you mean src/app/main.py?

detectors.title: An edit fails because the file changed since it was read
detectors.pattern: File has been modified since read
detectors.repro: File has been modified since read, either by the user or by a linter. Read it again before attempting to write it.

detectors.title: The command line is too long
detectors.pattern: The command line is too long|Argument list too long
detectors.repro: The command line is too long.

detectors.title: Compound and inline commands trigger permission prompts
detectors.pattern: requires approval|contains multiple operations
detectors.repro: This command requires approval

detectors.title: Structured output is rejected because the payload is nested
detectors.pattern: Output does not match required schema
detectors.repro: Output does not match required schema: root: must have required property 'findings'

detectors.title: Path length limit breaks deep paths on Windows
detectors.pattern: Filename too long|specified path, file name, or both are too long|path too long
detectors.repro: error: unable to create file deep/dir/file.txt: Filename too long

detectors.title: Scheduled-task quirks on Windows
detectors.pattern: 0x800710E0|operator or administrator has refused the request
detectors.repro: Last Result: 0x800710E0

detectors.title: The Microsoft Store Python alias stub hangs or denies
detectors.pattern: Python was not found; run without arguments to install from the Microsoft Store
detectors.repro: Python was not found; run without arguments to install from the Microsoft Store or disable this shortcut from Settings > Manage App Execution Aliases.

detectors.title: OneDrive holds a lock on files, or syncs a git repository, virtual environment or database
detectors.pattern: The process cannot access the file because it is being used by another process|Unable to create .*index\.lock|resource busy or locked
detectors.repro: PermissionError: The process cannot access the file because it is being used by another process: 'notes.db'

detectors.title: WSL DNS stops working while a VPN is connected
detectors.pattern: Temporary failure in name resolution|Could not resolve host|Name or service not known|getaddrinfo EAI_AGAIN
detectors.repro: ping: example.com: Temporary failure in name resolution

detectors.title: Unpinned npx and uvx runs fetch whatever is newest today
detectors.pattern: No matching version found for|npm (ERR!|error) (code )?E404|Could not find a version that satisfies the requirement|failed to start.*(npx|uvx)
detectors.repro: npm ERR! notarget No matching version found for example-mcp-server@latest-beta.

detectors.title: A policy denial is retried in another shape
detectors.pattern: blocked by (group policy|your organi[sz]ation|your administrator)|disallowed by (managed )?(policy|settings)|denied by managed settings|not allowed by (your )?(organi[sz]ation|admin)
detectors.repro: This program is blocked by group policy. For more information, contact your system administrator.

detectors.title: Two SSH clients on one Windows machine
detectors.pattern: Permission denied \(publickey\)
detectors.repro: git@example.com: Permission denied (publickey).

detectors.title: git in a plain folder reports a parent repository
detectors.pattern: fatal: not a git repository \(or any of the parent directories\)
detectors.repro: fatal: not a git repository (or any of the parent directories): .git

detectors.title: Untrusted text is substituted into a workflow script
detectors.pattern: is potentially untrusted
detectors.repro: script injection: "github.event.pull_request.title" is potentially untrusted. avoid using it directly in inline scripts

detectors.title: MCP connection gotchas
detectors.pattern: Not Acceptable: Client must accept|Missing session ID|Mcp-Session-Id|MCP-Protocol-Version
detectors.repro: Not Acceptable: Client must accept both application/json and text/event-stream

detectors.title: A model change is rejected by the API
detectors.pattern: does not support assistant message prefill|conversation must end with a user message
detectors.repro: anthropic.BadRequestError: {'type': 'error', 'error': {'type': 'invalid_request_error', 'message': 'This model does not support assistant message prefill. The conversation must end with a user message.'}}

detectors.title: A model change is rejected by the API
detectors.pattern: `?temperature`? is deprecated for this model
detectors.repro: anthropic.BadRequestError: {'type': 'error', 'error': {'type': 'invalid_request_error', 'message': '`temperature` is deprecated for this model.'}}

detectors.title: A model change returns blank or cut-off text
detectors.pattern: '(Redacted)?ThinkingBlock' object has no attribute 'text'
detectors.repro: AttributeError: 'ThinkingBlock' object has no attribute 'text'

detectors.title: A model change is rejected by the API
detectors.pattern: "thinking\.type\.(enabled|disabled)" is not supported for this model|To turn thinking off on this model, send
detectors.repro: "thinking.type.enabled" is not supported for this model. Use "thinking.type.adaptive" and "output_config.effort" to control thinking behavior.

detectors.title: A model change is rejected by the API
detectors.pattern: output_config\.effort '\w+' is not supported when thinking is disabled
detectors.repro: output_config.effort 'xhigh' is not supported when thinking is disabled on this model. Use effort 'high' or below, or enable thinking.

detectors.title: A recursive delete through a Windows junction empties the folder it points to
detectors.pattern: contains modified or untracked files, use --force to delete it
detectors.repro: fatal: 'C:/work/wt-fix' contains modified or untracked files, use --force to delete it

detectors.title: A container restart keeps the environment it was created with
detectors.pattern: (?s)^(?!.*(?:port is already allocated|address already in use|x509)).*variable is not set\. Defaulting to a blank string
detectors.repro: WARN The "API_URL" variable is not set. Defaulting to a blank string.

detectors.title: A bulk search-and-replace rewrites binary files
detectors.pattern: file is not a database|database disk image is malformed
detectors.repro: sqlite3.DatabaseError: file is not a database
